description: This file defines API routes for a FastAPI application managing production lines, shifts, runs, events, OEE metrics, alerts, reports, and WebSocket endpoints for real-time updates. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, ending runs, logging events, computing OEE, handling alerts, generating reports, and WebSocket communication for live data.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections for broadcasting real-time updates.

methods.name: realtime_docs
methods.description: Provides WebSocket usage instructions and message types.

methods.name: create_line
methods.description: Creates a new production line with a target OEE.

methods.name: create_shift
methods.description: Creates a new shift for a specified line.

methods.name: list_shifts
methods.description: Lists shifts, optionally filtered by line.

methods.name: end_run
methods.description: Marks a production run as ended.

methods.name: create_event
methods.description: Logs a production/downtime/quality event and broadcasts updates.

methods.name: get_oee
methods.description: Computes and returns OEE metrics for a specific run.

methods.name: list_alerts
methods.description: Lists alerts, optionally filtered by acknowledgment status.

methods.name: shift_report
methods.description: Generates a shift report for a specified time window.

methods.name: smoke_flow
methods.description: Performs an end-to-end smoke test: creates line, shift, run, logs events, computes OEE, triggers alerts, and generates report.

methods.name: ws_oee
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint for live OEE updates and alerts.
